item: {"addr": "0x140b6e1b0", "comment": "AddressLib ID 61809 (read 2026-11-16): Havok's single-threaded integrate of each active island (world+0x40). Each step: world+0x3E7 (step counter byte) ++, bits at world+0x3E5 toggled every 8 steps (the frame markers Activate writes into a body's counters). Per island: 0x140B838A0 (no constraints) or 0x140B889C0 -> 0x140B860F0 integrate the bodies and return the island's least deactivation count; over 5 with the island's active mark set and world+0x155 (wantDeactivation) on: markIslandInactive (61523), which only queues it. The final decision is 61522 -> 61507."}

{"addr": "0x140b838a0", "comment": "Integrates an island's bodies and counts their stillness (read 2026-11-16; Havok 2010 hkRigidMotionUtil). Per motion (entity+0x150): integrate counter +0x11 ++; every 4th step checks reference 0 (high frequency), every 16th reference 1 (low frequency). A check: w of the reference (motion+0x10C / +0x11C = entity+0x25C / +0x26C) = max(w, |v|^2 + min(r,1)^2 |w|^2); if the body is further than the class's maxDistSqrd[i] (solverInfo+100+28*class+16+4i) or turned past maxRotSqrd[i] from that reference: the reference is reset there (w zeroed by the mask) and its count (+0x12 / +0x14 low 7 bits) set 0; else the count goes up (saturating near 64). Returns the least, over the bodies, of max(count0, count1)."}

{"addr": "0x140b869c0", "comment": "The last test before an island sleeps (read 2026-11-16): for every body, (|v|^2 + min(r,1)^2 |w|^2) / 4 - 0.01 must be at most w of its reference with the higher count (entity+0x25C or +0x26C): the fastest it went at a check since that reference was set. A body speeding up (falling) fails it. hkpEntity::deactivate (60850) sets both w to HK_REAL_MAX, so a body it put to sleep passes this until it next moves off its reference."}

{"addr": "0x140b4b0c0", "comment": "AddressLib ID 60850 hkpEntity::deactivate (1.7.104, read 2026-11-16): only if its island is active. A split check pending on the island (+0x31 bits) splits it first (61513 with world +0x124 zeroed), so only bodies touching it share its fate; then every entity in the island (+0x60 array, +0x68 count) gets 0x7F7FFFEE (HK_REAL_MAX) at +0x25C and +0x26C and the island is marked inactive (61523). A pile sleeps together: a body cannot be put to sleep alone among others. +0x25C/+0x26C are the w of the motion's two deactivation references (motion+0x100/+0x110): the fastest the body went at a check since that reference was set, which the island's last sleep test (0x140B869C0, from 61507) compares the body's speed against. HK_REAL_MAX passes it whatever the body does, until the body next moves off that reference (0x140B838A0 resets it). The counts (+0x162/+0x164) are left as they were. Engine callers: bhkRigidBody::setActivated (0x141058D34), hkpEntity::deactivateAsCriticalOperation, 32117, 0x140B7F9C0, 0x141083040."}
